extracted.name: Quick Cheesy Garlic Bread
extracted.description: Recipe video above. The quickest and BEST way to make Cheesy Garlic Bread - just drizzle with melted garlic butter, bake, top with cheese then melt. Perfect shape for dunking into soups and stews, or upgrade any meal!
instruction_lines: Mix butter with garlic and salt.
Drizzle with garlic butter all over - don't miss any patches!
Bake 20 minutes until bread is crispy on the edges.
Crank oven up to 200C/390F. Top with cheese, bake 7 - 10 min until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Sprinkle with parsley if using, cut bread into pieces. Serve immediately as a side for meals, dunking in soups and stews!
